text:
maya: Quick sync — proposing a 2-week starter airdrop sprint: 100 credits to new signups + guided prompt pack + 3-day activation nudges. Run A vs B: onboarding prompt templates vs webinar invite. Benchmark: 1-week DAU, 7-day retention, prompt usage. Thoughts?

liam: Love the micro-sprint. Can we narrow to two personas: builders (API) and product folks (studio)? Different prompt packs.

sophia: Agreed. Builder pack = 5 API sample prompts + curl snippet. Product pack = template gallery + demo vid. Example builder prompt: "Summarize the JSON API response into bullet points for docs." And include `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`

ana: Landing copy idea: "Get 100 credits and ship your first feature in 30 mins" — short CTA, low friction.

cheng: Important: track template opens. We need single-click tracking link per template + UTM. Analytics should capture `template.opened` and `airdrops.claimed`.

sam: I can wire the UTM + events. Plan: `/api/airdrops/claim` returns `claim_id`. I'll instrument `airdrops.claimed`, `template.opened`, and `first_meaningful_request`. Will push a staging route today.

dev-bot: deployment scheduled for 2025-03-14 18:00 UTC — feature flag `airdrop_launch_sprint` will gate rollout.

maya: Timeline: kickoff tomorrow. Day1: prewrite launch posts + assets. Day2: designer + growth iterate. Day3: rollout to 50% of signups. Webinar as optional trigger on Day4 for low-engaged cohort.

liam: A/B specifics: cohort sizes ~2k each, randomization at signup. Metric hierarchy: activation rate (first meaningful request) > 30d conversion > LTV projection. Also capture prompt reuse within 7 days.

sophia: Need 3 launch post variations: benchmark narrative (latency/cost wins), what-we-built POV, and customer use-case post. I'll draft elevator copy for each and mock image direction.

ana: Also add in-app tooltip nudge 24–48h after claim: "Try these starter prompts" with two CTAs: "Run sample" and "Open templates".

cheng: One compliance note: don't auto-claim in restricted regions. Add consent flow for EU signups and exclude flagged orgs.

maya: Action items: sophia — draft 3 posts + images; liam — define cohort sql & metrics; sam — wire events + claim route; cheng — privacy filter + review; ana — landing CTA + microcopy; designer — produce 2 hero images. Deliver EOD tomorrow. :rocket:

sam: Deploying event hooks to staging now. Ping me if you want test creds or a demo script.

sophia: Dropping first drafts into #design-assets in ~3hrs and will ping here for quick feedback.

liam: I'll share randomization SQL and power calc in the morning.

maya: Quick product note — keep starter prompts model-agnostic and default to a lower-cost Llama-compatible variant; fallback to medium model for any prompt that exceeds token thresholds. That keeps unit economics predictable.

maya: Thanks all — short sprint, tight feedback loop. We'll run the first benchmark and recon in 7 days.
